body: Since upgrading to 2.4.0 the app crashes immediately on launch for all users on Windows. Stack trace attached. This is a regression, it used to work in 2.3.1. Error: NullPointerException in SessionStore.load.
title: App crashes on startup after upgrading to 2.4.0

body: Feature request: it would be nice to export the monthly report as a PDF from the dashboard. Please add an export button next to the CSV one.
title: Add support for exporting reports as PDF

body: Question: I cannot find where to configure how often failed webhooks are retried. Is it possible to set a custom backoff? The API docs mention retries but not the settings.
title: How do I configure the webhook retry policy?

body: The README quickstart has a typo in the install command and the API example still uses the removed v1 endpoint. Documentation fix only, good first issue for a new contributor.
title: Typo in the README quickstart and outdated API example

body: Performance issue: the dashboard takes 20+ seconds to render when a project grows past 10k tasks. CPU spikes in the browser. Probably the task list is rendered without pagination.
title: Dashboard is very slow when a project has more than 10k tasks
